justification: Image A shows schematic incised human figures with raised arms and geometric limbs on an otherwise plain surface, while Image B depicts a horizontal narrative band featuring a boat with a bird-headed prow, rows of small standing figures, and geometric fill patterns (crosshatching, chevrons) bordering the scene. The only loose commonality is the presence of human-like standing figures, but their form, grouping, and accompanying motifs (notably the boat and dense patterned borders in B, absent in A) differ substantially, giving little indication of a shared iconographic tradition.
